round: scaled hurdle GBDT - the one base family with headroom
why_this_and_not_more_sequence_models: Measured: perfect unregularised weighting of every base we own still loses to top-1 by 0.0011, so the deficit is in bases, not stacking.
Measured: seed averaging has only +0.00038 correlation left and the ridge already performs most of it.

Measured: for TCNs, anchor density behaves like epoch count and hurts. But for trees, denser anchors are extra ROWS, and the existing dense-anchor GBDT (GBD) is already our second best base at 1.651738 standalone.
The current production GBDT is modest: 17 anchors, learning_rate 0.05, ~300 rounds, 2 seeds. That is a plausible place for a coarse 0.002+ gain.
82% of achievable variance is the buy/no-buy event and the hurdle factorisation E[z] = P(y>0) * E[z|y>0] is EXACT, so improving the classifier is the highest-leverage single component.
validation_tool_is_matched_to_the_questi: fold 378 ranks coarse quality with Spearman +0.71 against the exactly-measured real-target quality, but has no resolution at 0.0001. This round hunts a COARSE base-level gain of 0.002+, which fold 378 can resolve. That is the opposite of the marginal gates that kept failing to transfer.
